meta.title: Christmas gift vouchers for cooking classes in Madrid
meta.description: Give an Asian cooking class in Madrid this Christmas. Vouchers from €25, emailed on Christmas morning or posted as a printed card.

hero.title: Gift an <mark>experience</mark>, not a thing.

cookies.text: Our website uses essential cookies to ensure its proper operation and tracking cookies to understand how you interact with it. Tracking will be enabled only upon your explicit consent.
cookies.prefsIntro: We use cookies to make this website work and to improve your experience. You can choose which categories to allow below and change your choice at any time. For more details, read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary cookies
necessary.text: These cookies are essential for the website to work properly, for example to keep you signed in or to remember your cookie preferences. They cannot be disabled.

analytics.title: Analytics cookies
analytics.text: These cookies collect anonymous information about how visitors use the website, such as the pages visited and the time spent on them, so we can improve it.

ads.title: Advertisement cookies
ads.text: These cookies are used to show you ads that are relevant to your interests and to measure how well our advertising campaigns perform.

cookies.moreText: If you have any questions about our cookie policy or your choices, please <contact>contact us</contact>.

meta.title: Team-building cooking classes in Madrid
meta.description: Private Asian cooking classes for companies: in our Madrid kitchen, at your office or online. Groups of 8 to 30, three hours, two event menus.

hero.title: The team that <mark>cooks together</mark>, stays together
hero.photoAlt: A group around a table folding dumplings, with bowls of filling and dipping sauce

formats.title: Pick your kitchen
formats.lead: The same chefs and recipes wherever you cook. Not sure which one fits? Tell us about your team and we suggest one.

wokLab.title: Cook in our kitchen
wokLab.text: Take over Wok Lab for a private session. The cooking stations, the dining table and the washing-up are ours.
wokLab.photoAlt: A chef showing a small group how to prepare a dish in the Wok Lab kitchen

office.title: Cook at your office or venue
office.text: Our chefs bring the woks, hobs and ingredients to your office, an offsite or an event space.
office.photoAlt: A chef slicing cucumber beside a wok on a portable hob

online.title: Cook along online
online.text: A live class streamed from our kitchen. Your team cooks along from home, on the video platform you already use.
online.photoAlt: Vegetables being stir-fried in a wok on a gas burner

session.title: How a three-hour session runs
session.lead: Every event follows the same four steps, whatever the menu.

welcome.title: Meet the chefs
welcome.text: Aprons on. The group splits into cooking stations and we walk through the ingredients.

prep.title: Prep in teams
prep.text: Each station folds, chops and mixes its part of the menu.

wok.title: Cook on the wok
wok.text: High heat and fast hands, with a chef beside every station.

eat.title: Eat together
eat.text: Everyone sits down to share what the teams cooked.

menus.title: Two menus for private events
menus.lead: Pick one when you request a proposal, or let us choose for your group. Tell us about allergies and diets and we adapt the dishes.

menus.photoAlt: A plate of freshly folded gyoza

impact.title: Cook double. <mark>Give half.</mark>
impact.text: Your team can cook twice as much, and we donate half to local shelters in Madrid. Tick it in the form and we plan the extra portions into your session.
impact.photoAlt: A chef guiding a guest as she stir-fries vegetables in a wok

experience.a: No. The chefs guide every step, from the first chop to the plate.

diets.q: Can you cater for allergies and diets?
diets.a: Yes, for most allergies and diets when you tell us in advance. Note them in the form and we adapt the dishes.

language.q: Is the class in English or Spanish?
language.a: Either one, or both for a mixed team. Tell us in the notes.

size.a: From 8 to 30 people. Tell us your number in the form.

price.a: The price depends on the format, the group size and the menu. Request a proposal and we send you a quote by email.

where.a: On Calle del Conde Duque in central Madrid, a short walk from the Noviciado and Plaza de España metro stations.
